traits.name: Combat Caster
traits.text:
The zealot can perform the somatic
components of spells even when it has weapons or a
shield in one or both hands.

traits.name: Danger Sense
traits.text:
The zealot has advantage on Dexterity
saving throws.

traits.name: Rage (2/Day)
traits.text:
As a bonus action, the zealot can enter a
rage for 1 minute. While raging, the zealot gains the
following benefits:
* Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving
throws
* Melee weapon attacks deal an addition 2 damage.
* The zealot gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing,
and slashing damage.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The zealot is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). The zealot has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): guidance, sacred flame * 1st level (4 slots): fog cloud, thunderwave * 2nd level (3 slots): gust of wind, shatter * 3rd level (3 slots): call lightning, sleet storm

traits.name: Thunderbolt Strike
traits.text:
When the zealot deals damage to a
Large or smaller creature, it can also push it up to 10
feet away from it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The zealot makes three attacks with its
warhammer.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5
ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, or
10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage while raging.
